### Standing Apart from Everyone Else
Author: Wendy Blight
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/standing-apart-from-everyone-else-encouragement-for-today-mar-22-2013.html
Passage: Leviticus 20:26
Points:
- Believers belong to God and are called not to conform to worldly standards.
- God's command for Israel to be holy was given out of love and carries great blessing rather than deprivation.
- Walking in holiness requires making difficult choices to step away from popular culture and worldly entertainment.
- Choosing to stand apart for the Lord brings the lasting reward of pleasing our heavenly Father.

### Who Cares about Leviticus?
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/who-cares-about-leviticus-crosswalk-the-devotional-march-8-2011.html
Passage: Leviticus 20:26
Points:
- Even though ceremonial requirements have passed away, Leviticus still illustrates God's call for His people to be set apart.
- God desires His followers to live, worship, and conduct themselves differently from the culture around them.
- Human attempts to fulfill the law reveal our profound inadequacy to achieve righteousness on our own.
- The impossibility of keeping the law magnifies how essential and wonderful God's grace truly is.
- Through Christ's sacrifice, believers are freed from the law and given the grace to live consecrated lives.
